ambiguities.resolution: No. Success, rank, factor logs, replay, bit complexity, and every resource axis still require proof and later validation.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: One exact constructor with support, all-strata, target-freshness, state, replay, success, and cost proofs, or one exact counterexample/lower bound for a declared family.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution; identify the first missing formula or theorem.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any missing formula, undefined stratum, hidden target advice, B^3 state, collision, unpaid replay, unknown success used as achieved, or unverified citation forces REVISE.
